summary: Stalwart is a Rust mail + collaboration server (IMAP/JMAP/SMTP/CalDAV/CardDAV/WebDAV): users manage mailboxes, email, contacts, calendars, identities, sieve scripts, push subscriptions and admin registry objects (accounts, API keys, domains, queues) through JMAP set/get/query methods over a custom KV object store, guarded by per-object ACLs and admin permissions.
